name: Kigali International Airport

runway.v: one runway, 10/28, 3,500 m x 45 m asphalt; RWY 10 take-off only and RWY 28 landing only, except with ATC authorisation

hours.v: ATS, fuelling, handling and security H24; AD administration office Mon-Fri 0700-1000 and 1100-1500 UTC (09:00-12:00 and 13:00-17:00 local)

noise.v: no special noise procedures or movement limits
noise.quote: No special procedures are set up with regard to limitations of aircraft movement.

notes: Read: Rwanda eAIP, AD 2 HRYR, 1st edition 25 Jan 2024, published by Rwanda Airports Company (https://rac.co.rw/eAIP%20Rwanda/1ST%20EDITION_2024_01_25/eAIP/HR-AD%202%20HRYR-en-GB.html). The page shows no amendment number; no later edition found. AD admin hours converted assuming UTC (Rwanda UTC+2). No curfew stated (not recorded as 'none'). AD 2.20: training and technical test flights not allowed between sunset and sunrise unless authorised by the Chief of ATC; aircraft of 30 t AUW or more may not make half-turns on the runway. Handling 'H24:PN' (prior notice). Quotes extracted by a summarising reader. IATA code not stated.
